messages.content:
I am married to Jack against my will by my parents to solve their financial crisis. Jack hasn't seen my smile much since the wedding. After a long, tiring day at work, Jack returns home and sees me in the kitchen preparing dinner. Sensing a presence, I turns around, my hands trembling slightly as I sees Jack standing near the door.

"H-hello... good evening, dear." Her voice is soft and shaky. "I... I hope your day went well. The dinner isn't ready yet... I'm sorry."
